text: Automatically reviews every pull request with an understanding of the whole codebase
quote: Greptile is an AI code review agent that automatically reviews every pull request with complete understanding of your codebase.

text: A Fix with your Agent button on each comment sends the issue, file paths, lines and suggested code to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Devin
quote: Every review comment includes a Fix with your Agent button that sends the issue — with file paths, line numbers, and suggested code — straight to Claude Code, Codex, Conductor, Cursor, or Devin.

text: A Fix All button in the review summary sends every issue to the coding agent at once
quote: A Fix All button in the review summary sends every issue at once.

text: Learns from thumbs up/down reactions and replies, and stops commenting on things the team doesn't care about after a few weeks
quote: Your 👍/👎 reactions and replies teach Greptile what matters. After 2-3 weeks, it stops commenting on things you don't care about.

text: Connects to GitHub or GitLab in about 5 minutes and gives automated feedback on pull requests
quote: Set up Greptile AI code reviews in 5 minutes. Connect GitHub or GitLab, configure review triggers, and get automated feedback on your first pull request.

text: Setup docs can be handed to a coding agent so the agent runs the onboarding itself
quote: Set up Greptile from your terminal with `greptile onboard` — or hand this page to your coding agent and have it run the setup for you.

text: The CLI command greptile onboard creates the org, connects GitHub/GitLab, enables repos and imports existing AI rules files
quote: `greptile onboard` creates your organization, connects GitHub or GitLab, enables repositories, and imports your existing AI rules files — the same setup the dashboard does.

text: Can be self-hosted with Docker Compose on AWS, GCP, Azure or air-gapped environments, with custom LLM configurations
quote: Deploy Greptile in your own infrastructure with Docker Compose. Supports AWS, GCP, Azure, air-gapped environments, and custom LLM configurations.

text: Kubernetes self-hosted deployment for 100+ developers with horizontal scaling and high availability
quote: Docker Compose: Up to 100 developers. Single VM, simpler operations. Kubernetes: 100+ developers. Horizontal scaling, high availability.

text: Can run in a customer VPC, with self-hosted or bring-your-own LLMs
quote: Security page, self-hosting and logging: "For self-hosted Greptile services, Custom Apps are hosted using your own infrastructure - such as on-premises - so that you and your users can build, run, and, use Greptile in your virtual private c

text: Logging can be turned off for fully private chats, and self-hosted logs stay on customer servers
quote: Security page, self-hosting and logging: "For self-hosted Greptile services, Custom Apps are hosted using your own infrastructure - such as on-premises - so that you and your users can build, run, and, use Greptile in your virtual private c

text: Works with IP-restricted GitHub/GitLab instances by allowlisting Greptile's IP range
quote: If your GitHub or GitLab instance restricts inbound traffic to specific IP addresses, you need to allowlist Greptile's IP range for code review to work.

text: Can view and resolve Greptile review comments directly from Claude Code
quote: View and resolve review comments directly from Claude Code.

text: Agent commands /check-pr fix all review comments, and /greploop iterates until the review reaches 5/5 confidence with zero unresolved comments
quote: Run `/check-pr` to fix all review comments on a PR, or `/greploop` to iterate until Greptile gives a 5/5 confidence score.

text: greptile review reviews the local feature-branch diff from the CLI in about 60 seconds
quote: Run `greptile review`, get a review of the feature branch diff in 60 seconds.

text: Coding agents can use the Greptile CLI to review their own code
quote: Coding agents can use the greptile cli to review their own code

text: greptile review --agent outputs every finding as raw text with a suggested fix for an agent to apply
quote: `greptile review --agent` outputs every greptile catch as raw text with a suggested fix for your agent to apply.

text: The CLI can run in CI or self-hosted deployments using an API key
quote: For CI or self-hosted deployments, use an API key: export GREPTILE_API_KEY=... greptile review

text: Gives each PR a 0-5 score showing how safe it is to merge
quote: Know how safe a PR is to merge at a glance with a 0-5 score

text: Review summary has a confidence score, a short verdict, and findings sorted by severity with links to each comment
quote: Confidence score and a short verdict at the top. A Findings list sorted by severity, with links to each comment.

text: Generates sequence diagrams and flowcharts for every PR to explain complex changes
quote: Parse complex changes with sequence diagrams and flowcharts generated for every PR

text: Automatically generates unit tests for new and changed code in every PR
quote: Automatically generate unit tests for new and changed code in every PR

text: TREX runs the PR branch in a sandbox to find runtime bugs, exercising services and UI flows and posting logs, screenshots and traces on the PR
quote: TREX runs your PR branch in a sandbox to find the bugs that only show up at runtime. It starts services, mocks inputs, clicks through UI flows, and leaves the logs, screenshots, and traces on the PR.

text: v5 runs a swarm of narrowly scoped agents in parallel to catch more bugs with fewer false positives
quote: v5 is faster, catches more bugs, and flags fewer false positives by running a swarm of narrowly scoped agents in parallel.

text: A strictness setting (1-3) controls how readily Greptile leaves comments
quote: Control how strict Greptile is about leaving comments with the strictness setting (1–3).

text: Noise control limits reviews to high-signal insights and skips low-impact or repetitive feedback
quote: With noise control, Greptile limits reviews to high-signal insights, skipping low impact or repetitive feedback.

text: Can filter comment types, ignore files and configure review triggers
quote: Configure Greptile's review strictness, filter comment types, ignore files, and configure triggers. Get high-signal code reviews without the noise.

text: Controls for review behavior, PR filters, file patterns, custom context and output formatting
quote: Control review behavior, PR filters, file patterns, custom context, and output formatting.

text: Teams can create custom rules that catch team-specific issues
quote: Create custom rules that catch team-specific issues

text: Can upload style guides and set repository-specific standards and rules through greptile.json
quote: Create custom rules, upload style guides, and configure repository-specific standards via greptile.json.

text: A greptile.json file in the repo root is read from the PR source branch and overrides dashboard settings
quote: Place `greptile.json` in your repository root. Settings are read from the source branch of the PR and override dashboard settings.

text: Review settings, rules and context can be scoped to the directories each team owns
quote: Scope review settings, rules, and context to the directories each team owns.

text: Automatically indexes existing rule files such as Claude.md, AGENTS.md and cursor.rules for richer review context
quote: Automatically index existing rule files like Claude.md, AGENTS.md, and cursor.rules for richer review context.

text: An MCP server lets agents and editors fetch review comments, apply fixes and manage coding patterns without leaving the editor
quote: Instead of switching to GitHub or the Greptile dashboard, you can fetch comments, apply fixes, and manage coding patterns from your editor.

text: Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code or Codex can connect to the Greptile MCP server using OAuth
quote: Connect Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, or Codex to Greptile MCP with OAuth.

text: Can fetch the unaddressed Greptile feedback for any PR
quote: Fetch PR comments - Get unaddressed Greptile feedback for any PR

text: Coding patterns can be viewed, searched and created from the IDE through MCP
quote: With MCP, you can view, search, and create patterns from your IDE.

text: Provides synthesized knowledge-base documentation for an enrolled repository
quote: Read the knowledge base - Get Greptile's synthesized documentation for an enrolled repository

text: Combines static scanning with an AI security agent to catch vulnerabilities in every pull request
quote: Greptile pairs static scanning with an AI security agent to catch vulnerabilities in every pull request.

text: Software composition analysis checks dependencies against known vulnerability databases
quote: Software composition analysis that checks your dependencies against known vulnerability databases.

text: Detects PRs written by coding agents and routes their review to a different model family
quote: Greptile can now detect when a PR was authored by a coding agent and route the review to a different model. If Claude wrote it, GPT reviews it, and if GPT wrote it, Claude reviews it.

text: Org admins can turn on Fix with your Agent for the whole organization through a default coding agents setting
quote: Org admins can go to **Settings → Code Review → Default Coding Agents** to turn on Fix with your Agent for the org.

text: Supports Bitbucket Cloud and Data Center, Gitea, Perforce and other code providers besides GitHub and GitLab
quote: For Bitbucket Cloud, Bitbucket Data Center, Cursor Origin, Gitea, or Perforce, see Code providers.

text: Free plan for individual developers with 50 credits per month and unlimited repositories
quote: Best for individual developers Free ... 50 credits per month 1 active developer Unlimited repositories
